#!/usr/bin/env sh
set -eu

# collect_env.sh
# Gather basic environment info useful for builds/diagnostics.

ARCH="$(uname -m 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
OS_NAME="$(uname -s 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
OS_RELEASE="$(uname -r 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
HOSTNAME="$(hostname 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
USER_NAME="$(id -un 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
USER_ID="$(id -u 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
GROUP_ID="$(id -g 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"

# Where to write. Allow override: COLLECT_ENV_OUT=/path/to/file
OUT="${COLLECT_ENV_OUT:-build_env.txt}"

{
  echo "timestamp_utc=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
  echo "hostname=${HOSTNAME}"
  echo "os_name=${OS_NAME}"
  echo "os_release=${OS_RELEASE}"
  echo "arch=${ARCH}"
  echo "user=${USER_NAME}"
  echo "uid=${USER_ID}"
  echo "gid=${GROUP_ID}"
} >"${OUT}"

echo "[collect_env.sh] wrote ${OUT}" 1>&2
